# AibhlínnAI

> AibhlínnAI is a small independent AI studio from South Australia. We build simple, calm tools for busy minds, and we help organisations make room for neurodivergent people. Our work covers apps, neuro-affirming event support, automation and AI consultancy, and neurodivergence advocacy.

Tagline: Aim for the gap. Simple tools to support busy minds.

**Key facts**

- Name: AibhlínnAI. One word, mixed case. If you cannot type the accent, AibhlinnAI is fine.
- Say it: AYV-leen A-I
- Business type: sole trader
- ABN: 70 810 791 817
- Based in: South Australia, Australia
- How we work: We work remotely as standard. If you would prefer us there in person, we can travel, and travel and accommodation costs are invoiced.
- Pricing for services: contact for pricing, hello@aibhlinn.ai
- Pie Timers Premium is a paid subscription. Pie Timers pricing is linked below.
- Enquiries: hello@aibhlinn.ai
- App support: support@aibhlinn.ai
- This website runs no scripts, sets no cookies, has no analytics and loads nothing from anyone else.

**Pie Timers**

Pie Timers is a countdown visual timer shaped like a pie that gets eaten as time passes. One glance tells you where you are in your day, without doing the sums.

- Made by AibhlínnAI.
- Free on one device, permanently: timers, your weekly schedule, appointments, the calculator, and alerts while the app is open.
- Runs in your browser with nothing to install, or as an Android app from Google Play.
- Works without an account, and offline.
- Premium adds sync between devices, a calendar connection and alerts when the app is closed.
- No ads and no third-party trackers.
- Pie Timers is a visual aid. It is not a medical device, a clinical tool or a substitute for professional advice.

**Services**

- Neuro-affirming event support: for conferences and other events we put your event program online as a live countdown visual timer. It shows on the big screens at your venue, and attendees open it on their own phones from a QR code, with nothing to install. We can also help you arrange planned breaks, times when a quiet space is open, and a printable program in plain language.
- Automation and AI consultancy: practical help finding the work that automation can take on in your organisation. We start with a small pilot, so you can see whether it helps before anything is rolled out.
- Neurodivergence advocacy: advocacy for access, choice and respect for neurodivergent people at work and in everyday life.

**How an automation and AI project runs**

1. Find the work. You tell us about the tasks that take up time in your organisation. Together we choose one that is small, repeated and easy to check.
2. Run a small pilot. We set up a pilot for that one task. The rest of your work carries on as it is.
3. See whether it helps. You see the pilot working on that task. We tell you plainly what worked and what did not.
4. You decide. Nothing is rolled out until you have seen the pilot and chosen to go on. If the pilot did not help, we say so.

We will tell you when automation is the wrong tool.

**Example of our work**

- Online event program for the Neurodivergent Entrepreneurs Expo, Adelaide, September 2026. On the day the live program ran on the big screen and on attendees' own phones from a QR code, with nothing to install.
